default: # Antigravity.md Management Plugin Tools to maintain and improve Antigravity.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current. ## What It Does Two complementary tools for different purposes: | | Antigravity-md-improver (skill) | /revise-Antigravity-md (command) | |---|---|---| | **Purpose** | Keep Antigravity.md aligned with codebase | Capture session learnings | | **Triggered by** | Codebase changes | End of session | | **Use when** | Periodic maintenance | Session revealed missing context | ## Usage ### Skill: Antigravity-md-improver Audits Antigravity.md files against current codebase state: ``` "audit my Antigravity.md files" "check if my Antigravity.md is up to date" ``` ### Command: /revise-Antigravity-md Captures learnings from the current session: ``` /revise-Antigravity-md ``` ## Author Isabella He (isabella@anthropic.com)
